# FG-KNOW-0006

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`knowledge`](../../ops/runbooks/knowledge.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `notes_create_twice_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: ノートはもうあるか、`notes` という名前が使われているため作れません。
- en: Your notes cannot be created: they already exist or the name `notes` is taken.
- id: Catatan Anda tidak dapat dibuat: sudah ada atau nama `notes` sudah dipakai.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 20 N1 (ADR-0040 §6): `POST /api/v1/user/notes` was refused before anything was written: `reason=already_exists` (the caller's pointer names a live `<user>/notes`; a concurrent creation that linked first also answers this), `reason=name_taken` (`<user>/notes` is already a project, a group or a tombstone of a moved path in the caller's namespace that is not the notes project; the chained FG-REPO-0009). Not a fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`, `user_id` and, for `already_exists`, `notes_project_id`; the request_id. `SELECT * FROM forge.user_notes WHERE user_id = <id>` shows the pointer.

## 対処 (fix)

`already_exists`: use the notes (`GET /api/v1/user/notes`). `name_taken`: rename or move the project that holds `<user>/notes` (or release the tombstone), then create the notes again. Runbook knowledge, 「Personal notes」.
